import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_61/training_0.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
source_dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    source_dfs.append(df)

# Since there is only one source table and its schema matches the target schema exactly,
# the transformation is simply to union (concatenate) all source tables.
# Here, only one source table exists, so the target is just that source table.

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (union)
target_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema columns are floats
target_df = target_df.astype({'0': float, '1': float, '2': float, '3': float})

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_61/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
